# Spar 0.6.4

**UI improvements in the agent thread. The session history behind a challenge
card opens as a stack you can scroll instead of a list that pushes the card
down the transcript, and the card itself drops the hover glow it never needed.**

## The agent thread

- **The session pile opens upward.** Opening the history used to slide the live
  challenge card down the transcript to make room. The card you are reading now
  holds still and the session unfolds above it.
- **It scrolls once it is long.** A session with a dozen stops used to fan out
  past the top of the view, every row shrunk and tilted until it could not be
  read. The pile is capped, scrolls, and fades at both ends, and it opens looking
  at the stop you are on rather than the first one of the session.
- **Depth lives in the motion, not the resting state.** Rows stand up out of the
  card as the pile opens, nearest first, and settle flat and legible.
- **Closed, the rest of the session sits under the live card** as a couple of
  slivers — enough to say there is a pile here, without a second card competing
  with the one you are reading.
- **The challenge card loses its hover glow.** It was stacking a wide diffuse
  shadow on top of the shadow the card already had.

## Around it

- Run folds, the composer, collapsible panels and activity rows pick up matching
  spacing and typography fixes.
- Training tools and the agent worker are refactored behind the scenes; agent
  policy and tool contracts move with them.
